quirks: Payment FAILS at the facilitator: endpoint's 402 paymentRequirements use network 'base' (legacy x402 v1 string) which the CDP facilitator rejects with 'payment_invalid' / invalid_request — network must be a CAIP-2 id like eip155:8453.
Pre-flight 402 looks payable (probe.payable=true) but the actual pay attempt cannot settle. No USDC was spent (paid:false, costUsd:0).
Do NOT retry — the malformed paymentRequirements are server-side; retries cannot succeed until the provider fixes the network field.
usage.guide: This endpoint is currently uncallable. GET https://vpsagent.fly.dev/catalog returns a 402 with x402 paymentRequirements whose network is the legacy string 'base' instead of a CAIP-2 id (eip155:8453), so the CDP facilitator rejects the payment with error 'payment_invalid' and the call cannot be settled. No money is lost, but no catalog data is returned. Treat as broken until the provider fixes the network field.
